fusions.name: Closed Quarters
fusions.desc: Bars close on the first enemy within 6 tiles and musk fills them, dealing 26 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. The target is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeking Bars
fusions.desc: Raises a row of bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that deals 12 damage to each enemy crossing it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Box
fusions.desc: Sets a box trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 20 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Animal
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a jet of musk hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 15 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
